planets.name: TOI-3757 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-3757 with a 3.44-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-3757 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-3757. Its orbit and size follow Kanodia et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname KANODIA_ET_AL__2022): disc_year 2022, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.438753, pl_radj 1.07057014, pl_bmassj 0.26838381

quotes.title: TOI-3757 b
quotes.card: TOI-3757 b is a gas giant exoplanet located in the constellation of Auriga 578 light years, or 177 parsecs, away from Earth.
quotes.introduction: TOI-3757 is a M0 red dwarf star, which are very rare hosts for gas giant planets.
